description: Dinucleotide relative abundance (Karlin odds ratio) rho_XY = f_XY / (f_X * f_Y): single-strand rho (default; = seqinr rho / EMBOSS compseq Obs/Exp) or Karlin's strand-symmetrized rho* (sequence + reverse complement). rho > 1 over-, < 1 under-represented; only occurring dinucleotides are keys. Optional Karlin classes (rho <= 0.78 under, >= 1.23 over). Not the Gardiner-Garden & Frommer CpG O/E used for CpG-island calling.

strandSymmetric.description: true: Karlin strand-symmetrized rho* over the sequence and its reverse complement (alphabet A/C/G/T); false: single-strand rho over A/C/G/T/U

includeRepresentation.description: true: also return Karlin's representation class per returned dinucleotide

ratios.description: Map of dinucleotide -> odds ratio rho (or rho*)

representation.description: Only with includeRepresentation: dinucleotide -> UnderRepresented (rho <= 0.78) / Normal / OverRepresented (rho >= 1.23)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
